input.summary: Add licence-back for bespoke Modifications and confirm Sparkling owns its data
input.comment: [Playbook] Garman may keep ownership of its platform, but Modifications built and paid for by us must come with a perpetual, irrevocable licence to use and modify them, and our data must remain ours. We have added a single sentence to that effect rather than reversing the ownership provision.

ops.oldText: No title to the intellectual property in the Work is transferred to Sparkling by this Agreement.
ops.newText: No title to the intellectual property in the Work is transferred to Sparkling by this Agreement. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Sparkling retains all right, title and interest in and to Sparkling's data and Confidential Information, and Garman grants to Sparkling a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and have modified the Modifications and any Improvements developed specifically for Sparkling, for Sparkling's internal business purposes.

input.summary: Extend the licence to contractors acting for Sparkling and make it transferable to a successor
input.comment: [Playbook] Our licences must cover contractors acting on our behalf and must follow the business in an M&A transaction. We have added contractors and successor transferability to the grant in Section 2 with minimal edits.

ops.oldText: for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations, a non-transferable and non-exclusive licence to use
ops.newText: for the use of Sparkling, affiliated companies of Sparkling and contractors acting on Sparkling's behalf, in each case at Authorized Locations, a non-exclusive licence, transferable to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all of Sparkling's assets, to use
